name: gnalloy linux full parity matrix
notes: Linux 完整对标矩阵：TCP、UDP、HTTP/1.1、HTTP/2、HTTP/3、HTTPS TLS 1.1/1.2/1.3 与纯 QUIC stream。HTTP/2 over TLS 跳过 TLS 1.1，HTTP/3/QUIC 固定 TLS 1.3；gnet、fasthttp、netpoll 仅执行各自真实支持的等价协议。

scenarios.name: fasthttp tcp echo unsupported
scenarios.skipReason: fasthttp is an HTTP server framework, not a raw TCP echo framework

scenarios.name: netpoll udp echo unsupported
scenarios.skipReason: CloudWeGo netpoll does not expose an equivalent UDP server API in this harness

scenarios.name: fasthttp udp echo unsupported
scenarios.skipReason: fasthttp is HTTP-only and cannot execute UDP datagram echo

scenarios.name: gnet https1 unsupported
scenarios.skipReason: gnet benchmark harness intentionally measures the native poller and does not wrap TLS

scenarios.name: netpoll https1 unsupported
scenarios.skipReason: netpoll benchmark harness intentionally measures the native poller and does not wrap TLS

scenarios.name: gnet http2 unsupported
scenarios.skipReason: gnet does not provide an HTTP/2 codec in this benchmark harness

scenarios.name: fasthttp http2 unsupported
scenarios.skipReason: fasthttp does not provide an HTTP/2 server implementation

scenarios.name: netpoll http2 unsupported
scenarios.skipReason: netpoll benchmark harness does not include an HTTP/2 codec

scenarios.name: gnalloy epoll https2 tls11 unsupported
scenarios.skipReason: HTTP/2 over TLS requires TLS 1.2 or newer

scenarios.name: netty epoll https2 tls11 unsupported
scenarios.skipReason: HTTP/2 over TLS requires TLS 1.2 or newer

scenarios.name: gnet https2 unsupported
scenarios.skipReason: gnet benchmark harness does not provide HTTP/2 over TLS

scenarios.name: fasthttp https2 unsupported
scenarios.skipReason: fasthttp does not provide an HTTP/2 server implementation

scenarios.name: netpoll https2 unsupported
scenarios.skipReason: netpoll benchmark harness does not provide HTTP/2 over TLS

scenarios.name: gnet http3 unsupported
scenarios.skipReason: gnet does not provide an HTTP/3 over QUIC codec in this benchmark harness

scenarios.name: fasthttp http3 unsupported
scenarios.skipReason: fasthttp is HTTP/1 oriented and does not provide HTTP/3

scenarios.name: netpoll http3 unsupported
scenarios.skipReason: netpoll benchmark harness does not provide HTTP/3 over QUIC

scenarios.name: gnet quic stream unsupported
scenarios.skipReason: gnet does not provide a QUIC transport

scenarios.name: fasthttp quic stream unsupported
scenarios.skipReason: fasthttp does not provide a QUIC transport

scenarios.name: netpoll quic stream unsupported
scenarios.skipReason: netpoll does not provide a QUIC transport
